_comment: Containment guard for headless local-model agent runs on Marvin (rb-hpc, user crv1pi), sandboxed. Pass with --settings so it stays OUTSIDE the folder the agent can edit. Headless `claude -p` cannot answer a prompt; defaultMode acceptEdits only covers file edits and every Bash call was refused (2026-08-27). `auto` mode is unavailable behind a custom ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL (needs Anthropic's classifier). So: bubblewrap sandbox + autoAllowBashIfSandboxed -- Bash runs without prompts because the OS confines it. Filesystem: the run folder (cwd), /tmp and the Triton/torch caches are writable; the repo (task notes, published TTT-Discover kernels, ICL/Shinka results), other agent runs and the Claude project memories are unreadable -- enforced for Bash children too, not just the Read tool.

permissions._comment_deny: Never deny-Read a parent of the run folder: Read/Write tool rules have no allow-override (deny wins), so Read(//home/crv1pi/agent_runs/**) blocked the agent from its OWN files (attempt 2, 2026-08-27: it fought the guard for 236 turns and quit). Other agent runs live in ~/agent_runs_archive and are hidden by the sandbox for Bash and by this rule for Read.

sandbox._comment: bwrap/socat are absent on the GPU compute nodes (present on login nodes); copies live in ~/.local/bin (shared home). User namespaces are enabled on the compute nodes, verified 2026-08-27.
sandbox._comment_gpu: bubblewrap does not bind /dev/nvidia*, so a sandboxed grader sees no GPU (smoke 2026-08-27: cuda False, NVML init failed). The grader invocation alone runs unsandboxed via excludedCommands + the matching Bash allow rules; everything else stays confined. KPY is ~/.local/bin/kpy-serial (flock + exec real python): it is the ONLY unsandboxed command, so it is the only route to the GPU, and it serialises evaluations.
sandbox._comment_forbid: Do NOT set allowUnsandboxedCommands to "forbid": with it, nothing was auto-allowed any more (smoke 65641140: grader, touch, even the Write tool all fell back to permission prompts). Stay on true; the prompt tells the agent that dangerouslyDisableSandbox requests are always refused.
